briefdescription.para: The Darwin variadic PCS places anonymous arguments in 8-byte stack slots.

detaileddescription.para: An [N x Ty] type must still be contiguous in memory though.

briefdescription.para: Given an [N x Ty] block, it should be passed in a consecutive sequence of registers.

detaileddescription.para: If no such sequence is available, mark the rest of the registers of that type as used and place the argument on the stack.
